issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
enforcement_authorities: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
implementation_notes: This document is a compilation of public comments received in response to NIST's Request for Information (RFI) on the AI Risk Management Framework, submitted between July and September 2021. It does not itself constitute policy but aggregates stakeholder input used to inform framework development. No binding requirements, prohibited practices, or penalties are established by this document.
